description: Aéroports issus de la BDCARTO de l'IGN sur Auvergne-Rhône-Alpes is a dataset listed in Open platform of French public data, a catalogue harvested into the European data portal, published or maintained by DREAL Auvergne-Rhône-Alpes. Ce sont les aéroports extraits de la BDCarto de l'Institut Géographique National pour Rhône-Alpes et Auvergne. Sont retenus tous les aérodromes ouverts à la circulation aérienne publique, à usage restreint, de l'état ou inutilisables Les aérodromes privés sont exclus. Coverage: DREAL Auvergne-Rhône-Alpes. The publisher named on the listing is DREAL Auvergne-Rhône-Alpes. Its keywords include auvergne-rhone-alpes, gestion-des-crises-et-des-risques, gestion-de-crise. The listing shows 2013-04-25 as the last modification. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is not stated on the portal listing (dataset page not read). Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support transport network, traffic and access studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-eu-plateforme-ouverte-des-donnees-publiques-francaises.
